about: The shop's own sections: whole repositories whose mods are listed on a page of their own instead of the Mod Shop's shelves (app.js, renderSection). A repository's later releases land in its section by themselves. Each pack is one repository; its title and blurb head its shelf there. A section's tools are pages of the site (a #view) listed under it.

sections.title: Splash & screens
sections.blurb: Your own boot splash from a PNG or GIF, a few examples to start from, and full-screen pictures for the Digitakt and the Digitone. One splash per build: any two draw over the same boot intro.

packs.title: DigiSplash
packs.blurb: Five example splashes, including Elektron's rare stock intro. The rest of the set is on DigiSplash's release.

packs.title: DigiCandy
packs.blurb: Eye candy on command: a full-screen picture over whatever is running (Digitakt TRK + YES, Digitone MIDI + YES). Five examples; the rest of the set is on DigiCandy's repository.
